I hereby give notice for information of General Public that as per Secretary's Decision No. 2025.04.23,03 and dated 23, April, 2025, road and paths and included in this Schedule should be declared as road and paths belonged to Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha as an action hasn't been instituted in competent court for the date assigned in the said notification for the roads and paths including in the notification declared in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2419/46 and dated 18th January, 2025, under the order made under the Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha by the series of orders with regard to publishing notices specifying the register for preparing plans for roads and paths maintained by Pradeshiya Sabha in Sabaragamuwa Province, having been declared in Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2316/20 and dated 24th of January, 2023 by Hon. Governor in Sabaragamuwa Province read as Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987. I hereby further notify that a register with regard to said road and paths in inclusive of the schedule hereto and every road and path included thereto should be deemed as roads and paths belonged to Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub-section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act. Navoda Krishanthi, Secretary and Executing Officer for Powers, Duties and Functions Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha. At Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha,At Pitagaldeniya,30th of May, 2025.
